name: agent-flat-function-namespace-default-reserved
description: Port-only: without flatFunctionNamespace a flat function namespaced with a reserved runtime name (inputs) is filed under tools as before, with the warning; 'own' raises TypeScript's error for it (agent-flat-function-namespace-own-reserved).

functions.name: lookup
functions.description: Look up a customer by id

expected_deprecations: An agent calls a flat function tools.<name> even when the function names its own namespace; TypeScript Ax calls it <namespace>.<name>. Pass flatFunctionNamespace: 'own' to use the function's namespace now, or flatFunctionNamespace: 'tools' to keep tools. The function's own namespace becomes the default in the next major version.
